fact: Femintech, an institution launched in 2017 with partners including Unicef, teaches digital literacy, AI and programming, and about a thousand girls have received the training since its start (Femintech's outgoing president).
UNESCO's project 3210652071 (USD 166,800, 66% progress, 2024-2025) on digital skills and media and information literacy for populations is on going, with an allocation to this country (DR Congo 20%).
